rules: Preserve valid authored PBR maps from dedicated production GLBs.
Do not replace valid PBR with basecolor-only integration materials.
Do not regenerate geometry for a confirmed surface-only defect.
Calibrate environment/light after source PBR preservation.
validation_remaining: Unity material evidence after glTFast shader preservation

integration_fixes.detail: Dedicated production GLBs use BenchmarkPiece instead of basecolor-only BenchmarkPieceIntegrated.
AdaptForUrp now preserves Shader Graphs/glTF-* and glTF/* shaders instead of rebuilding them as URP/Lit, retaining metallic-roughness, normal, AO and emission semantics.
